description: ToolListed is a curated AI tools directory and product submission platform built for indie makers, SaaS founders, AI tool creators, SEO professionals, marketers, and website owners who want to increase product visibility and build useful website backlinks. The platform helps users submit AI tools, SaaS products, productivity apps, online generators, calculators, developer tools, marketing tools, and indie websites into a clean directory where people can discover useful online products.
